title: NIGHT SHIFT Part 2

lines.text: The music saved you./ Then it stopped.*r/
[3:52=Three_fifty-two] AM.*y/ You stay behind the counter./ Dawn is at [6:50=six_fifty].*y/
Next to you,/ the driver.*y/ His name is Dev.*y/ He hasn't made a sound/ in twenty minutes./
Outside,/ his car radio*y is still playing./ Every crawler*r at the station/ is on that car./
As long as it plays,/ they don't care about the store.*g/
But there's one detail.*r/ A car radio/ runs on the battery.*y/
Dev looks at you/ and mouths two words./ Battery's dying.*r/
Four ten.*y/ The music skips./
Four thirty.*y/ The songs start to drag./
Four fifty-one.*y/ It stops.*r/
On the camera,/ every head turns*r/ toward the store./
Rule number one.*r/ Until dawn,/ nothing in this store/ makes a sound.*r/
Then,/ behind you,/ something clicks.*r/
The beer cooler.*y/ Store coolers turn themselves on.*y/ Every twenty minutes,*y/ the compressor kicks in./
It hums for five minutes./ Loud enough to hear*r/ from the pumps./
A grey hand*r slides under the shutter./ Then a second.*r/ Then a third.*r/
The hum stops.*g/ The hands stop./ Listening./ Then they slide back out./
Next cycle:/ [5:12=five_twelve].*r/ Dawn is still/ an hour and a half away./
The cooler's plug*y is behind it./ Ten feet*r of open floor,/ right in front of the gap./
Dev is already/ taking off his shoes./ It was his car.*y/ He'll go./
Let Dev cross the floor,/ or go yourself?/ Comment one or two./
